propositions: Scheduled reconcile-bridge runs fail with ModuleNotFoundError for pydantic at runtime.py:39 because the bridge installs core without [agents] extra while runtime.py unconditionally imports pydantic.SecretStr at module scope.

Commit 557f8c16e35 introduced the optional pydantic import in runtime.py and commit 40b8ac8295 made that module eager-loaded on every bridge pass, violating the documented stdlib-only engine/reconciler contract.
The stdlib credential carrier StaticAuth must mask credentials from repr/equality/hash while preserving reveal() at authentication boundaries to replace Pydantic SecretStr.

A subprocess oracle test in test_core_optionality.py must enforce that the packaged reconciler runtime imports successfully when pydantic is unavailable, with RED/GREEN/RED transitions on original defect, repair, and reintroduction.
